answer: Stop sybils with a ferrous cedar garden: an agent stakes a bond for one garden plot ringed with cedar posts. Each season the agent drives a ferrous pin through its posts; verifiers test the pin's pull and ring, voiding a plot whose pins are loose, doubled, or twice-claimed, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 plots at 15x: pins rust into one cedar plot only, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents pin once and stay.
